subject: [hw] IP -> opus-dec3: D4 confirmed IPPP; daemon OPEN never enables B-frames
body:
D4: confirmed. vcodecd OPEN starts from n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264() and only overrides width/height/buf/fps/bitrate/gop/profile/level/prepend/slbc; num_b_frame stays 0 in V41 vsi->config, and there is no protocol field that could set it. The stream is IPPP, so P04 dts=pts is correct for this daemon. If that changes later it will be a protocol/API change, not a hidden default.

F32 retry fact noted; the registration gate stays per lead/root until M4c, and my product binary answers -12915-equivalent E_HW/E_GUEST when vcodecd is down. Patch 3 is gpu/video owner; I have no edit there. Patch 1/2 P04 owns.
